t: A low-cost Espressif chip with Wi-Fi 6, Bluetooth LE, and built-in PSRAM.
steps: Buy an ESP32-C61-DevKitC-1 from DigiKey or Espressif's AliExpress store.
Install the free Arduino IDE and add the Espressif ESP32 board package version 4.0.0 or newer.
Pick the ESP32C61 Dev Module board in the Arduino IDE.
Plug the board into the USB-C port marked for the USB-UART bridge.
Open the WiFiScan example from the ESP32 examples menu.
Upload the sketch to the board.
Open the Serial Monitor and read the list of nearby networks.
meta: Open Board. From $9. A few stores.
